title: Geodesics: an Algebraic Topological Abstraction of Go - Connectivity and Incidence Generalized.
excerpt: Go's rules never needed the board to be a flat grid — so Geodesics lets you play on a sphere, a torus, a Möbius band, or a 3D lattice, tiled however you like, with the mathematics explained on hover.

title: Leveraging Topology to Advance Machine Learning Models and Methods
excerpt: A short tour of my PhD dissertation: keeping the learning problem entirely inside the topological domain, from Morse–Smale priors graphs to hierarchical, filtration-learning graph neural networks.

title: Topological Neural Operators: A Runnable Ablation Tutorial
excerpt: A self-contained, paper-style notebook probing whether the Hodge decomposition gives a neural operator the right inductive bias for PDEs on domains with holes.

title: Morse–Smale Complexes for Unsupervised U-Net and Graph Learning
excerpt: An early experiment in topology-as-supervision: can the Morse–Smale complex of an image stand in for hand-drawn labels? Two attempts — an inductive GNN over MSC arcs, and a U-Net trained on multi-persistence MSC segmentations.

title: Restoring a 1973 Oldsmobile Cutlass Supreme
excerpt: A running log of the repair jobs, guides, and hard-won lessons from working on a 1973 Cutlass Supreme.

title: Dynamical Systems Orchestration: A Lava-Lamp Synthesiser
excerpt: Turning a lava lamp into a performable instrument with persistent homology, optical-flow tracking, and a sixteen-voice polysynth.

title: Hodge Dynamics: Currents, Committors, and Cycles
excerpt: The discrete Hodge decomposition reads a system's committor, its non-equilibrium circulation, and its metastable basins at once, on toy potentials and on real molecular dynamics.
coverAlt: Harmonic winding current on a driven torus
